DELEGATION OF POWERS UNDER CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES STATUTE No. 03 of 1998 OF THE WESTERN PROVINCIAL COUNCIL

I, Hanif Yusoof, the Governor of the Western Province, according to the powers vested upon me under the section 02 (2) of the Co-operative Societies Statute of Western Provincial Council No. 03 of 1998 that shall be read with the Act, 154 (c) of the constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, hereby notify that powers speciﬁ ed under the Column III of its schedule will be delegated to the post holders mentioned in Column II, corresponding to the names of Column I in the following schedule, that is appointed to assist the Commissioner of Co-operative Development of Western Province and the Registrar of Co-operative Socities of the Western Province with eﬀ ect from 24th March 2025.
At the Oﬃ ce of the Governor of Western Province,Located at the Western Province Council Building,Battaramulla.on the 30th day April 2025.
